scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('Chart.yaml','utf8'); if(!/^name: dflow$/m.test(t)) { console.error('Chart.yaml name is not dflow'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const v=fs.readFileSync('values.yaml','utf8'); if(!v.includes('dflowUI:')) { console.error('values.yaml is missing dflowUI'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('Chart.yaml','utf8'); if(!t.includes('Apache-2.0')) { console.error('chart license annotation missing'); process.exit(1); }"
